'''High Flight Three Beta''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying a reconnaissance unit during the [[Battle of Adumar]]. The pilot reported the arrival of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

*''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'' {{1st}}
